title: Four AM Zimbabwe (Zimbabwe Family)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk prominent thumb piano hosho shakers ngoma drums urban grooves acoustic guitar 80bpm analog tape warm atmospheric dawn Shona Zimbabwe heritage multilingual
lyrics:
[Intro — mbira only]

[Verse 1]
Before Australia, before the flight, before the gate
There was a farm at four AM in Zimbabwe
The hosho marking time before the clock existed
The ngoma calling the workers to the misted

[Verse 2]
This is what the instruments of other countries carry
Not just music — the whole morning of a world
The mbira thumb piano says — I remember the red dust
The hosho says — I remember the rhythm and the trust

[Chorus]
Four AM Zimbabwe
The world before the world wakes up
Four AM Zimbabwe
The mbira in the morning cup
Jeff and Jill and Kerri and the farm
Four AM Zimbabwe — still warm

[Bridge]
In Italy they have the accordion at dawn
In Germany the church bells call the morn
In Japan the taiko starts the sun
But in Zimbabwe — the mbira is the one
That calls the family to begin
Before the light, before the day moves in

[Verse 3]
Ari doesn't know this yet
But someday she will ask why
She rises before she needs to
Why the morning feels like music
Why the four AM feels like home
Even in Australia — even alone

[Outro — mbira returning under vocals]
Four AM Zimbabwe
Four AM Zimbabwe
The mbira plays on
Four AM
